title: J1 Datum C kinematic implementation baseline
context: Datum A mating face and Datum B central pilot already establish the axial position and transverse axis of the P003-P016 joint. Datum C shall constrain the remaining rotation about B without creating a redundant radial locating constraint.
chronology: 2026-09-02: radial-slot implementation documented in K01_DATUM_C_KINEMATIC_DECISION.md / K01_DATUM_C_FREEZE_SPEC.json.
2026-09-03: serviceable-joint architecture, manufacturing router and Gate04B v3-v7 evolved the same kinematic intent into a relieved/diamond P017 locator with a simple round P003 mating hole.
2026-09-09: Gate04B v7 executed on current stable A001 and passed pattern derivation plus native P003/P016 candidate generation.
2026-09-10: Gate04B producer corrected the P003 mating feature to controlled Ø3.02 +0.01/0 THRU geometry and made model-to-sketch coordinate mapping explicit.

2026-09-10: candidate A001 Assembly QA PASS: 14 modeled occurrences, P003/P016/P017 fully constrained, 0 active mate errors, P017 signed press depth/protrusion 4/2 mm, moving-group propagation PASS and 0 unexpected IN/MID/OUT interference.

selected.B: central pilot, Ø10 H7/g6 locating architecture
selected.C: K01-P-017 relieved/diamond locator pressed into P016 and engaging P003 Ø3.02 +0.01/0 round hole
selected.P016_pin_hole: Ø3 H7 x 4.0 blind at R12 and pattern-derived free-gap midpoint
selected.P017: Ø3 p6 press shank x4; protrusion 2.0; tangential major 3.00 -0.01/0; radial minor 2.80 ±0.02; 316L baseline

kinematic_reason: The relieved/diamond locator preserves the radial-relief intent of the earlier radial-slot concept: its major width controls tangential clocking while the relieved minor dimension provides radial freedom. The current implementation is later, has a simpler drilled P003 feature, is already represented in the manufacturing router, and has native Gate04B v7 PASS evidence.

gate04b_v7_facts.status_note: Producer release_status records the pre-assembly-QA build state; assembly_qa_status is the later controlling candidate-integration evidence.

does_not_supersede: Rule that fasteners clamp only and do not locate
Requirement that Datum C remove only the remaining rotational DOF
release_condition: Candidate assembly QA condition is satisfied. Canonical/product release remains blocked until controlled promotion, post-promotion semantic verification, snapshot/stale reduction, BOM refresh and all applicable P0-P6/technical-filter release gates pass.
